Ivy (Marketing): Quick alignment for the release next Wed. Need the usual by EOD tomorrow: changelog bullets, public doc links, benchmark link we can cite, exact rollout times (UTC) so we can schedule blog + webinar + press embargo, and a sample webhook payload for Sales routing.

Ben (Eng): We can freeze tomorrow. Changelog (copy verbatim):
- Adaptive KV cache improves tail latency for long-context runs
- New int4 runtime lowers inference cost on smaller GPUs
- Fixed a batching edge-case that caused duplicate tokens in rare cases
Commits: b7c8d9..e0f1g2
Rollout plan: Canary 2027-08-04 04:00 UTC (30m, 5% -> 25% if healthy), full by 05:15 UTC. No API schema changes.

Arun (Bench): Publishable numbers: p50 (1k tokens) = 110ms on A100; ~35% cost reduction vs baseline. Public notebook: https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/v2-4-public. Owner: arun@redwood.ai.

Maya (Docs): I'll push permalinks today: release notes, migration guide anchor, and FAQ for the webinar.

Ben (Eng): Webhook sample for signups to route to trials@redwood.com:
{ "email": "u@ex.com", "org": "Org", "plan": "trial-30d", "model_variant": "int4", "utm_campaign": "v2_4_launch" }
We can add a tags array on request.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by @ben. Canary window 2027-08-04T04:00:00Z -> 2027-08-04T05:15:00Z.

Ivy (Marketing): Thanks — I'll schedule the blog 5m after full rollout and put the webinar at 17:00 UTC same day. Posting social copy + UTM templates in this thread tomorrow AM. Ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
